name: Dumbbell Forearm Supination

rehabilitation.clinical_protocol: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program

steps: Sit with your elbow bent at 90 degrees and your forearm resting on a table, holding a light dumbbell or hammer upright.
Grip the lower portion of the handle to provide asymmetric rotational resistance.
Start in the vertical neutral position with your thumb pointing up.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward so your palm turns upward to face the ceiling.
Hold for 1 second in full supination, contracting the supinator and biceps muscles.
Slowly return the dumbbell back to the vertical starting position.
coaching_cues: Ensure your elbow remains firmly against your side or the table; do not let your elbow flare out.
Control the outward rotation slowly over 2 seconds; do not let the weight drop.
Keep your wrist straight and firm throughout.

sources.attribution: AAOS Wrist and Forearm Conditioning Program
